H2.title: Release procedure ships a sidecar that cannot launch
H2.resolution: Fixed the bug rather than documenting it: identity_source_path() hashes sys.executable when sys.frozen, matching what the supervisor hashes for plan.identity_file. Frozen child now reaches the launch-contract check (rc=2) instead of dying in executable_identity(). releasing.md gains the identity_file wiring note.
